description.en: Alibaba Cloud OpenAPI MCP connection for DeepSeek Harness: static-credential mode through the official OpenAPI MCP proxy, exposing ECS / OSS / DNS / Function Compute APIs as mcp__aliyun__* tools.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的阿里云 OpenAPI MCP 连接：静态凭证 + 官方 MCP Proxy，把 ECS / OSS / 域名 / DNS / 函数计算等 OpenAPI 暴露为 mcp__aliyun__* 工具。
